title: Arkret Field Patch (ak.schema.patch.v1)
description: Canonical field-patch format embedded in event payloads (typically at payload.patch) for non-create updates. This is a registered schema id (ak.schema.patch.v1) describing the structural form of a patch map; the embedded format identifier 'ak.patch.v1' remains the in-prose name for the same wire shape. Implementations MUST resolve ak.patch.v1 references in spec prose to this schema artifact. Grammar, parser responsibilities, selector semantics, redactable-field protection and reducer-managed-field protection are defined normatively in zh/models/event-and-patch.md §4.

propertyNames.$comment: Patch path syntax. Snake_case identifier, optional dot-separated segments, optional stable-key selectors (`field[<key>=<canonical-json-string>]`) and backtick-quoted literals for non-snake_case keys. Full ABNF in zh/models/event-and-patch.md §4.2.1. Maximum length 1024 bytes, maximum nesting depth 16 segments — exceeding either MUST yield reason_code patch_path_invalid.

oneOf.$comment: Direct value form: equivalent to {"$op":"set","value":<value>}. Any JSON value EXCEPT a JSON object containing a $op discriminator may use this form.
Explicit op object form. $op is required; value is required for set/add/remove; value MUST be absent for unset.
